preconditions.description: The number of rows (and columns) in the board, n, is between 3 and 100 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.split()) == int(stdin.split()[0]) and all(len(line) == int(stdin.split()[0]) for line in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: The output consists of n lines, each containing n characters.

postconditions.expression: all(char in 'WB' for line in stdout.split() for char in line)
postconditions.description: Each character in the output is either 'W' (white knight) or 'B' (black knight).
The number of duels between knights of different colors is maximized.
